title: Why Your Weight Changes From Day to Day
description: Understand why daily weight readings change, what a scale can tell you, and how to put the number in context.
author: Healthy Weight Literacy Foundation

hero.alt: Illustration of a bathroom scale with its display off beside a stool and folded towels.

body.alt: Invented teaching example, not patient or trial data: seven readings are 180.0, 181.0, 179.8, 180.6, 179.7, 180.4, and 180.1 pounds. It illustrates fluctuation, not an expected range, target, or weighing schedule.

source.title: NHS: consistent conditions for recording weight
